summary: Clean modern weekly page: a red-and-black serif wordmark, colour-coded header tabs (red for jobs, black for apartments, black town sub-tabs), a mix of centred boxed ads in assorted fonts and justified town-led liners, stock photos as fillers, and a blue house-ad column taking a swipe at Craigslist.

frame.masthead: Running head with page number, red rule, then 'Observer' in red flared small caps and 'Classifieds' in black; small italic disclaimer paragraph below.
frame.footer: Full-width notary services display with photo background and red title bar.

headers.notes: Two-line caps in a red box; APARTMENTS FOR RENT uses the same box in black; SERVICES OFFERED red again.
Town names as black sub-tabs inside the rentals.

units.notes: Town name in bold caps leads; run code (33W03) at end; separated by short grey rules.

units.example: TRUCK DRIVER / 40 hour week / Monday - Friday...
units.notes: Every box picks its own font (Arial, Georgia, condensed sans), all centred.

units.example: PART TIME & FULL TIME / A chance to grow...
units.notes: Yellow and bright cyan fills as paid upgrades.
Stock photos used to fill space in a section.

notes: Colour-coding header tabs by section (red jobs, black housing) is a simple, reusable token.
